name: CSO_SCH_SEARCH_OVERRIDE
description: This table stores details which allows customers to manipulate search results for a given search term, boosting or blocking specified documents.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: A value indicating the 'action' to be performed by the search override service like boost or block the document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: This is a reference to document table record.

columns.name: LOCALE
columns.description: This is a referenece to locale table record.

columns.name: VOCABULARY_ID
columns.description: This is a reference to vocabulary table record.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This is used to represent the expiration date.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
